title: armeria elongata var. macloviana
intro: Armeria elongata var. macloviana, commonly known as the Welsh poppy or sea pink, is a species of flowering plant in the primrose family, Primulaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in herbal medicine to promote respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate stress. The health benefits of Armeria elongata var. macloviana include its ability to soothe coughs, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
